title: Flow over them with your waves and with your waters
html_source:
From Deirdre a play by AE.

The Deirdre legend was popular at the time with AE and Synge writing a Deirdre play.

Synge’s was finished by his girlfriend, Molly Algood and Yeats after dying at 37 years of age from cancer.

Deirdre was the subject of a prophecy by the druid, Cathbad, that she would kill the king, Conchubar. She was secreted away and was beautiful when grown up. She fell in love with a warrior Naoise (neesha) and eloped with him.

The legend tells the story of Conchubar tracking these two down and the bloody consequences.
The allusion is to a line in Deirdre , AE Let thy waves flow over them spoken by Cathbad in a curse against the heroes chasing Deirdre. AE/George Russell played this part when the play was first produced (Gifford).
